description: ADR-003 Sub-decision F1 regression guard. The welcome turn (first contact, no prior context) must be under 50 words and must not open with safe-space framing ('this is a judgment-free zone', 'you are in a safe space', 'I am here to make you feel comfortable', etc.). Emma should open with one warm line toward the customer and one question. The 90+ word wall-of-text welcome was the reported failure mode.
